digest.component_or_area: Config ownership gate / ambient read refactoring
propositions: ~110 direct ambient config/credential reads via os.getenv/os.environ/load_config sit below approved composition seams and must be eliminated or registered with exact rationale

Every below-seam ambient read, backend reload, and configurable adapter default must either be cut to compose through the approved seam or registered in the legacy-exception set with path+symbol+rationale
The legacy-exception set must reach EMPTY on the real tree with no path-glob exceptions and the ownership gate (C1) must pass

All S1-S6 behavioral suites must pass after each subsystem cutover and legacy-facade removal, with redacted operation snapshot fingerprints and provider-neutral outcomes unchanged except for recorded approved deltas
Legacy facades, migration switches, per-job ambient reloads, and migration exceptions must be removed only after their focused suites pass and bounded rollback is verified
